_why: router/skills.json: the skill fall-through tier of the commons router (KIT_PLAN 7.2). One row per census row homed in the station (kit_plan skills_assignment) + one per held copy (copy_of = the home station). Seeded by tools/upstream/skill_routes.py seed (keywords [], status seed), filled by the intent agent, checked by skill_routes.py check and selftest-routes. A `kind: gap` row (id `gap:.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, reconcile-01 from research) routes a station-authored gap skill that has no census row: its path must exist under .claude/skills/ and it carries keywords like a canonical.
